news.titleEn: CNBC Fed survey: Two rate hikes seen ahead
news.conclusionEn: The Federal Reserve is widely expected to raise interest rates by a quarter point to a 3.75%-4.00% range today, with a CNBC survey pointing to a further hike likely before year-end.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储今日料加息25基点至3.75%-4.00%，调查显示年内或再加息一次。
news.whyEn: This would be the Fed's first rate hike since 2023 under new Chair Kevin Warsh, directly affecting mortgages, credit costs and stock valuations worldwide while inflation stays above target.
news.whyZh: 这将是美联储2023年以来首次加息，直接波及全球房贷、信贷成本与股市估值。
news.detailEn: The Federal Reserve concludes its two-day policy meeting today, September 16, with the rate decision due at 2 p.m. ET followed by a press conference from Chair Kevin Warsh. A Reuters poll found 86 of 101 economists expect a quarter-point hike to 3.75%-4.00%, and a CNBC survey of economists points to a further hike before year-end as inflation stays elevated, with August CPI running at 3.4% annually. Warsh has emphasized that high inflation should be the Fed's 'predominant focus,' putting him at odds with President Trump, who has repeatedly pushed for rate cuts. Markets will watch not just the rate itself but the updated 'dot plot' of future projections and how Warsh frames risks in his press conference.
news.detailZh: 美联储将于今日（9月16日）结束为期两天的政策会议，利率决议将于美东时间下午2点公布，随后美联储主席凯文·沃什将召开新闻发布会。路透社调查显示，101位受访经济学家中有86位预计将加息25个基点至3.75%-4.00%区间；CNBC的调查也指出，鉴于8月通胀年率仍达3.4%，年内可能还会再加息一次。沃什强调高通胀应是美联储「首要关注点」，这一立场与一再要求降息的特朗普总统形成分歧。市场关注的不仅是利率本身，还包括最新的「点阵图」利率预测，以及沃什在发布会上如何评估风险。

news.titleEn: U.S. oil tops $105 as Saudi Arabia reportedly cancels some crude cargoes after pipeline closure
news.conclusionEn: Oil prices extended their surge, with U.S. crude topping $105 a barrel, after reports that Saudi Arabia has begun canceling some crude cargo shipments following last week's Houthi attack that shut its key East-West pipeline.
news.conclusionZh: 沙特输油管遇袭后传出取消部分原油出货，美国原油涨破105美元。
news.whyEn: Saudi Arabia is the world's largest oil exporter, so disruption to its shipping commitments threatens global supply just as the Fed weighs a rate decision complicated by energy-driven inflation.
news.whyZh: 沙特是全球最大原油出口国，其供应中断威胁全球能源市场并加剧通胀压力。
news.detailEn: U.S. West Texas Intermediate crude rose above $105 a barrel and Brent climbed toward $109, extending a rally that has pushed prices up roughly 20% this month. The gains followed reports that Saudi Aramco has told some customers it may not fulfill full crude cargo volumes after a Houthi drone and missile attack forced the shutdown of the kingdom's East-West pipeline, the main alternative route for bypassing the Strait of Hormuz. Iran has separately claimed a tanker struck a mine inside the strait itself, raising fears that two of the world's most critical oil corridors are simultaneously at risk. Goldman Sachs analysts said the escalation raises the probability that Brent could exceed $120 a barrel if the disruption persists.
news.detailZh: 美国WTI原油价格升破每桶105美元，布伦特原油逼近109美元，延续本月以来约20%的涨势。此轮上涨源于有消息称，沙特阿美已告知部分客户，因胡塞武装无人机及导弹袭击迫使沙特关闭其绕开霍尔木兹海峡的关键替代通道——东西输油管道，公司可能无法足额交付原油出货。伊朗方面另称一艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡本身触雷，令外界担忧全球两条最关键的原油通道同时告急。高盛分析师表示，若局势持续升级，布伦特原油价格突破每桶120美元的概率正在上升。

news.titleEn: China bristles at Anthropic CEO's 'fearmongering' about its AI development
news.conclusionEn: China's foreign ministry pushed back against Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's essay warning that a Chinese lead in AI would be dangerous, calling it 'fearmongering' just over a week before Presidents Trump and Xi are due to meet.
news.conclusionZh: 中国外交部反驳Anthropic CEO「中国AI领先构成危险」言论，斥为「危言耸听」。
news.whyEn: The spat adds friction to US-China tech competition right before a high-stakes summit where AI export controls and governance are expected to be major topics.
news.whyZh: 这为中美科技竞争再添摩擦，恰逢两国领导人即将就AI议题举行峰会。
news.detailEn: In a weekend essay, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei argued that a Chinese lead in artificial intelligence 'would pose grave danger for the United States and the world,' and called for the US to maintain export restrictions on advanced AI chips and chipmaking equipment to China. China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs responded that such warnings were counterproductive, with a spokesperson saying 'fearmongering, confrontation and vicious competition will only disrupt the process of global AI governance.' The exchange comes just over a week before Presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping are scheduled to meet on September 24, a summit expected to touch on AI governance among other issues. Trump has separately dismissed calls to slow US AI development, saying doing so risked letting China 'eclipse' American AI leadership.
news.detailZh: Anthropic首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪周末发文警告，「中国在人工智能领域领先将对美国及全世界构成严重威胁」，并呼吁美国继续对华限制出口先进AI芯片及芯片制造设备。中国外交部回应称，此类警告适得其反，发言人表示「危言耸听、制造对立与恶性竞争只会扰乱全球AI治理进程」。这番交锋发生在特朗普与习近平预定9月24日举行会晤前一周多，此次峰会预计将涉及AI治理等议题。特朗普此前也曾驳斥放缓美国AI发展的呼吁，称此举可能让中国在AI领域「反超」美国。

news.titleEn: Poland and Ukraine slam Russian strike on train near their border as 'escalation'
news.conclusionEn: A Russian drone struck a Kyiv-Warsaw passenger train just two kilometers from the Polish border, prompting NATO chief Mark Rutte to pledge increased support for Ukraine and Poland to call a high-level security meeting.
news.conclusionZh: 俄军无人机袭击距波兰边境仅2公里的基辅至华沙客运列车，北约誓言加强援乌。
news.whyEn: The strike landed dangerously close to NATO territory just after a separate train carrying senior EU officials passed through the same station, intensifying fears the war could directly draw in alliance members.
news.whyZh: 袭击地点极度接近北约领土，加剧战争外溢至北约成员国的担忧。
news.detailEn: The drone hit a passenger train traveling from Kyiv to Warsaw near Yahodyn in Ukraine's Volyn region, about two kilometers from the Polish border, forcing an evacuation of the train's roughly 206 passengers; no injuries were reported. NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte said the strike, occurring 'close to NATO territory,' showed Russian President Vladimir Putin's 'desperation and also his desire to sow fear and terror,' and pledged the alliance would boost support for Ukraine and strengthen its eastern border defenses. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk called a high-level security meeting with defense and interior ministers in response. The strike occurred shortly after a separate train carrying senior EU officials and former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson passed through the same station, underscoring how close it came to hitting Western officials directly.
news.detailZh: 这架无人机袭击了一列从基辅驶往华沙的客运列车，地点靠近乌克兰沃伦州的亚戈丁，距波兰边境仅约2公里，导致列车上约206名乘客紧急疏散，所幸无人受伤。北约秘书长马克·吕特表示，此次袭击发生地「靠近北约领土」，显示出俄罗斯总统普京的「绝望，以及散布恐惧与恐怖的意图」，并承诺北约将加强对乌克兰的支持并强化东部边境防御。波兰总理图斯克随即召集国防与内政部长举行高级别安全会议。值得注意的是，就在袭击发生前不久，另一列载有欧盟高级官员及英国前首相鲍里斯·约翰逊的列车刚经过同一车站，凸显此次袭击距直接命中西方官员仅一步之遥。

news.titleEn: Indonesia searches for 129 people missing after ferry capsizes in the Java Sea
news.conclusionEn: Indonesian authorities intensified their search for 129 people still missing after the ferry Virgo Transport 8, carrying more than 240 people, capsized in rough seas in the Java Sea, with six confirmed dead and 108 rescued so far.
news.conclusionZh: 印尼客轮「Virgo Transport 8」在爪哇海翻覆，129人仍失踪，6人遇难。
news.whyEn: The disaster is one of the deadliest passenger ferry accidents in the region in years and highlights recurring maritime safety concerns across Indonesia's vast archipelago.
news.whyZh: 这是该地区多年来最严重的客轮事故之一，凸显印尼航运安全的长期隐患。
news.detailEn: The Virgo Transport 8, a 119-meter ferry built in Japan in 1987 and now operated by PT Virgo Karya Shipping, lost contact with authorities around 2 a.m. Sunday while sailing from Surabaya to Banjarmasin on Borneo Island, before overturning in the Java Sea's Masalembo waters amid waves up to three meters high. Search teams grew to 655 personnel, deploying 17 ships and aircraft alongside navy underwater thermal drones to look for survivors. Officials said they remain hopeful of finding more people alive as the search continues, though with more than half the roughly 240 people aboard still unaccounted for, it ranks among the deadliest ferry incidents in the region in recent years.
news.detailZh: 「Virgo Transport 8」号客轮长119米，1987年在日本建造，现由印尼PT Virgo Karya Shipping公司运营。该船周日凌晨2时左右在从泗水驶往加里曼丹岛班贾尔马辛途中与当局失联，随后在爪哇海马萨伦博海域遭遇最高3米巨浪，不幸翻覆。搜救队伍已增至655人，出动17艘船只及飞机，并派出海军水下热成像无人设备协助搜寻幸存者。官员表示仍对找到更多幸存者抱有希望，但由于船上约240人中逾半数仍下落不明，此次事故已成为该地区近年来最惨重的客轮事故之一。

news.titleEn: Senate cloture vote on Clarity Act fails, dealing regulatory blow to crypto industry
news.conclusionEn: The US Senate failed to advance the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, with only 49 of the needed 60 votes, effectively ending crypto market-structure legislation for 2026 and sending Bitcoin down toward $76,000.
news.conclusionZh: 美国参议院加密监管法案未获足够票数通过，比特币跌至7.6万美元附近。
news.whyEn: The bill would have been the first comprehensive US framework for regulating crypto markets, and its failure removes regulatory certainty the industry had spent years lobbying for.
news.whyZh: 该法案原将成为美国首个全面加密监管框架，失败令行业多年游说落空。
news.detailEn: The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, which would have clarified how the SEC and CFTC oversee crypto markets, fell short in a Senate cloture vote, with 49 senators voting yes against 50 no votes, including all Democrats plus four Republicans. Opponents cited insufficient ethics provisions to restrain conflicts of interest, pointing to President Trump's crypto business ties, which generated an estimated $1.4 billion in revenue in 2025. The failure effectively ends market-structure legislative work in the Senate for 2026, a significant setback for an industry that lobbied heavily for the bill. Bitcoin slipped toward $76,000 and crypto-linked stocks including Coinbase, Circle and Bullish extended losses following the vote.
news.detailZh: 《数字资产市场明晰法案》原本将明确美国证券交易委员会（SEC）与商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）对加密市场的监管权责划分，但在参议院终止辩论投票中未能过关，仅获49票赞成，不敌50票反对，反对方包括全体民主党议员及4名共和党议员。反对者认为该法案的道德操守条款不足以约束利益冲突，并指出特朗普总统本人的加密货币业务在2025年创造了约14亿美元收入。此次失败实际上意味着参议院年内的加密市场结构立法工作已经终结，对多年来大力游说推动该法案的行业而言是重大挫折。投票结果公布后，比特币跌至7.6万美元附近，Coinbase、Circle、Bullish等加密概念股跌幅进一步扩大。

businessTips.explanationEn: The sunk cost fallacy is the tendency to keep investing time, money or effort into a decision because of what has already been spent, rather than because of what makes sense going forward. Sunk costs — money already spent, hours already worked — are gone no matter what happens next, so rational decisions should only weigh future costs and benefits. Managers fall into this trap when they keep funding a failing project 'because we've already put so much into it,' rather than asking whether they would start that project today knowing what they now know. Recognizing sunk cost thinking is one of the simplest ways to make faster, clearer business decisions.
businessTips.explanationZh: 沉没成本谬误是指人们因为已经投入的时间、金钱或精力，而继续投入某项决策，而不是基于未来是否值得继续做出判断的倾向。沉没成本——已经花掉的钱、已经付出的工时——无论接下来怎么做都无法收回，因此理性决策应只考虑未来的成本与收益。管理者常陷入这一陷阱：因为「已经投入这么多了」而继续为一个失败的项目输血，而不是反问自己，如果以今天掌握的信息重新出发，是否还会启动这个项目。识别沉没成本思维，是让商业决策更快、更清晰的最简单方法之一。
businessTips.exampleEn: A company has spent $500,000 building an internal software tool over a year, but a much cheaper off-the-shelf product now does the job better. A manager influenced by sunk cost thinking argues 'we can't stop now, we've already spent so much,' while a clear-eyed one asks only whether finishing the internal build is the best use of the next dollar, regardless of the $500,000 already gone.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家公司花了一年时间、投入50万美元开发内部软件工具，但如今市面上有更便宜的现成产品能更好地完成同样的工作。受沉没成本思维影响的管理者会说「都投了这么多，不能现在停下」，而思路清晰的管理者只会问：不论已经花掉的50万美元，继续完成这个内部项目是否是下一笔钱最值得的用途。

businessTips.explanationEn: A minimum viable product is the simplest version of a product that still lets a founder test a core assumption with real customers, before investing heavily in building out every feature. The goal of an MVP is not to launch something impressive, but to learn as cheaply and quickly as possible whether people actually want what you're building. Many side-hustle founders waste months polishing a product no one asked for; an MVP approach forces them to get real feedback early, even if the first version is embarrassingly basic. Common MVP formats include a landing page that measures signup interest, a manually-run service before any software is built, or a single-feature app.
businessTips.explanationZh: 最小可行产品（MVP）是指产品最简化的版本，足以让创业者在大规模投入开发全部功能之前，用真实客户验证核心假设是否成立。MVP的目标不是打造一个令人惊艳的产品，而是以最低成本、最快速度弄清楚人们是否真的需要你正在做的东西。许多做副业的创业者会花费数月打磨一个根本没人需要的产品；而MVP方法则迫使他们尽早获得真实反馈，哪怕第一版简陋到有些「拿不出手」。常见的MVP形式包括用来测试注册意愿的落地页、在开发软件之前先靠人工提供服务，或者只做单一功能的App。
businessTips.exampleEn: Before building a full meal-planning app, a side-hustle founder creates a simple landing page describing the idea and asks visitors to sign up for early access. If only a handful of people sign up after real marketing effort, the founder learns cheaply that demand may be weak, saving months of development time compared to building the full app first and finding out later.
businessTips.exampleZh: 在开发完整的膳食规划App之前，一位做副业的创业者先做了一个简单的落地页，介绍产品创意并邀请访客注册抢先体验。如果在真实推广后只有寥寥数人注册，创业者就能以极低成本提前意识到需求可能不足，相比先把完整App做出来才发现问题，节省了数月的开发时间。

businessTips.explanationEn: Duration measures how sensitive a bond's price is to changes in interest rates, expressed roughly as the percentage a bond's price will move for each one-percentage-point change in rates. A bond with a duration of 7 will lose approximately 7% of its value if rates rise by one percentage point, and gain roughly 7% if rates fall by the same amount. Longer-maturity bonds generally have higher duration and are more volatile, while shorter-term bonds have lower duration and are more stable when rates move. Understanding duration helps investors judge how exposed their bond holdings are to a central bank decision, rather than just looking at the bond's stated interest rate.
businessTips.explanationZh: 久期衡量的是债券价格对利率变动的敏感程度，大致可理解为：利率每变动一个百分点，债券价格会相应变动的百分比。久期为7的债券，若利率上升1个百分点，其价值大约会下跌7%；若利率下降1个百分点，价值则大约上涨7%。期限越长的债券，久期通常越高、价格波动也越大；期限越短的债券久期越低，利率变动时价格相对更稳定。理解久期能帮助投资者判断自己持有的债券在央行决策前后究竟面临多大的价格风险，而不只是看债券票面利率高低。
businessTips.exampleEn: An investor holding a 20-year Treasury bond with a duration of around 15 watches the Fed prepare to raise rates by a quarter point; that single move could push the bond's price down by roughly 3-4%. A second investor holding a 2-year note with a duration near 2 would see a much smaller price drop from the same rate hike, illustrating why long-duration bonds are riskier when a rate decision is uncertain.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位投资者持有久期约为15的20年期美国国债，当美联储准备加息25个基点时，这一举动可能导致该债券价格下跌约3%-4%。而另一位持有久期约为2的2年期国债的投资者，面对同样的加息，价格跌幅则要小得多，这说明在利率决策存在不确定性时，长久期债券的风险更高。
